# Ixchel Beach Hotel — Rooms 603 & 604 (Direct from Owner)

> Private vacation rental suites at Ixchel Beach Hotel, Playa Norte, Isla Mujeres, Mexico.
> Booked directly from the private owner — not through the hotel's front desk or third-party platforms.

## What This Is

This website represents two privately owned rooms (603 and 604) inside the Ixchel Beach Hotel on Playa Norte, Isla Mujeres, Quintana Roo, Mexico. The owner rents these rooms directly, offering guaranteed specific rooms, personal service, and competitive rates.

Playa Norte is consistently rated one of the most beautiful beaches in the world: calm turquoise Caribbean water, white powder sand, and a relaxed island atmosphere.

## Room Options

### Room 604 — King Suite
- 1 king bed
- Private balcony with panoramic Caribbean Sea views
- Living area with sofa and TV
- Kitchenette
- Air conditioning
- Maximum occupancy: 2 guests (recommended)

### Room 603 — Standard Room
- 2 double beds
- Beautiful window view of the Caribbean
- Air conditioning
- Maximum occupancy: 4 guests

### Rooms 603 & 604 Combined — Two-Bedroom Suite
- 1 king bed + 2 double beds
- Full kitchen, two bathrooms, living areas
- Private balcony with panoramic ocean views
- Ideal for families or groups of up to 6

## Location

**Address:** Playa Norte Centro S/N, Centro, Isla Mujeres, Quintana Roo, Mexico, 77400
**Google Maps:** https://maps.app.goo.gl/nnrn9pq7YKeQk98h7
**Coordinates:** 21.2358° N, 86.7319° W

Isla Mujeres is a small island 13 km off the coast of Cancún, accessible by ferry. Playa Norte is on the northern tip of the island.

## Amenities

- Direct access to the famous Playa Norte beach
- Private ocean-view balcony (Room 604 and combined suite)
- Swimming pool (shared hotel pool)
- Air conditioning
- Kitchen / kitchenette
- Fitness center
- On-site restaurant and bar
- Complimentary beach chairs, towels, and umbrellas
- Access to water sports and scuba diving arrangements
- Free WiFi
- Walking distance to restaurants, shops, and nightlife in Isla Mujeres Centro

## Rates & Pricing

Rates are in USD per night and include all taxes. Use the rate calculator at https://ixchel603and604.com/#calculator to get an estimate for specific dates and room type. The site also shows a live availability calendar.

Approximate price range: $$$

## Booking Policies

- **Check-in:** 3:00 PM
- **Check-out:** 12:00 PM
- **Pets:** Not allowed (service dogs with documentation only)
- **Quiet hours:** After 10:00 PM. No parties.
- **Visitors:** Restricted to lobby until 10:00 PM.

### Payment

- May 1 – Dec 20: 50% deposit at booking; balance due 15 days prior.
- Dec 21 – Apr 30: 50% deposit at booking; balance due 30 days prior.
- Credit card charges appear as "OPER HOTELERA".

### Cancellation

- 31+ days before arrival: Full refund.
- 30 days or less: 100% non-refundable.
- No-shows: Non-refundable.

### Room Guarantee

Booking Rooms 603 and/or 604 through this website guarantees those exact rooms. This is a key differentiator from booking other room types at Ixchel Beach Hotel, where specific rooms and floors are assigned at check-in.

## Awards & Recognition

- Ixchel Beach Hotel holds a **TripAdvisor Travelers' Choice 2025 Award**
- **5-star Facebook reviews** from past guests

## How to Book

Contact the owner directly via:
- **Website contact form:** https://ixchel603and604.com/#contact
- **Facebook / Messenger:** https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100083058382774

The owner personally handles all bookings and submits the reservation directly with the hotel operator. Information needed to book:
- Full name, email, telephone, home address
- Number of adults, number of children (and ages if applicable)
- Desired check-in and check-out dates
- Room type preference (Room 603, Room 604, or both)
